correctness.rationale: The complete proof reduces positivity to the nondecreasing sequence \(b_k\) by exact graded diagonalization. Degree trace telescopes. Coordinate squared singular weights are diagonal, giving uniform p-moment comparability. Counting at least \(c_dK^d\) entries on degree shells proves weak-ideal necessity, and a simplex lattice-volume limit gives the beta-moment constant and logarithmic residue. Exact rational finite checks passed (231 assertion sets). Boundary \(p=q_d\), \(d=2\), zero tuple, and noncompact unbounded-\((b_k)\) possibilities were explicitly considered. Finite tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The main question concerns compact positive sum-of-commutators, for which ordinary one-operator hyponormal rigidity fails. The theorem classifies an entire \(U(d)\)-symmetric model, identifies a universal sharp weak-Schatten index, and upgrades total defect trace into an explicit singular-value spectral residue independent of how the defect is distributed by degree. This is a natural stability/invariant fact, not just a one-parameter recomputation or an existence variation.
